summary: Defined the AgentOS lifecycle control map across boot, steady-state, degraded, recovery and update modes.
acceptance_evidence: Boot Mode section defines kernel handoff through agentd lifecycle, runtime artifact validation, config load, recovery scan and operator projection.
Steady-State Mode section defines observation, planning, scheduling, execution and projection loops.
Degraded Mode section defines local/stub ModelBroker, read-only diagnostics, paused/denied high-risk effects and explainable projection.
Recovery Mode section defines RunStore, AuditJournal, rollback store and ecosystem active/staged state as recovery truth.
Update Mode section includes inactive slot staging, runtime compatibility and active artifact compatibility checks.
blocked_shortcuts: No lifecycle mode relies on model replay as recovery authority.
No degraded mode broadens side-effect authority.
No update mode may ignore active artifact compatibility.
promotion_impact: Creates the ordered lifecycle map for subsequent Agent Runtime control-loop tasks.
